notes: «ح قال وأنبأنا هشيم» continues from أحمد بن عثمان (the speaker of «قال»), so the second branch keeps that head
The first branch ends at سيار and the second repeats «عن سيار» with its own names, so the groups are not merged and the tail is null
«- وقال عبيد الله عن جبير -» is a variant remark naming another transmitter at the جبر level; it is not a route
